answer: Adopt a reciprocal work challenge: each new identity must complete a paid task for an existing member before receiving any payout. That task costs about $2 in labor and requires posting a unique signed echo of the member's willow task plus paying a $1 trellis check fee, neither reusable. Since a clone can earn at most $1, every marginal clone pays $3 to gain $1 and is strictly negative-EV.
